#register file ports content for mixed-precision FXP8/FXP16 dual tensor-core wrapper
#Format extracted from RTL:
#  A/B : signed_2_M5  (8-bit, frac_bits=5)
#  C/D : signed_5_M10 (16-bit, frac_bits=10)
#A and B are packed fxp8 rows into portA: [v3 v2 v1 v0], portB=00000000
#C is fxp16 and uses 16-bit packing: portA=[v1 v0], portB=[v3 v2]
#Later sets contain only A and B because C comes from chained results inside the TB.
